description: Replace Unix domain socket RPC transport with Windows named pipes for Electron↔helper communication. Named pipe path: \\.\pipe\cove-replay-engine-{pid}. Implement in both Rust helper (tokio named pipe server) and Node.js (net.connect to named pipe). Maintain the same JSON-RPC protocol. Handle pipe access permissions, connection retry, and clean pipe teardown. Linux path unchanged — conditional at transport layer only.
title: Windows RPC transport (named pipes)
